# Computer started (`boot`)

**Kind:** trigger · **Category:** Computer & sign-in · **Available in:** machine automations

Fires once each time the computer starts, before anyone signs in.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `include_fast_startup` | true / false | no | `true` | Also fire when Windows starts with Fast Startup (the default shutdown mode on most PCs, which is really a hibernate). Turn off to react to full restarts only. |

## Example

```yaml
triggers:
  - type: boot
    include_fast_startup: true
```

## Notes

Only available in machine automations, because no user is signed in at boot. To change a user's own settings (theme, audio, ...) at startup, use the `logon` trigger instead. The service remembers the boot time, so restarting the service does not fire this trigger again.
